overview: Brick-built display-scale LEGO minifigure inspired by the reference: a white-robed hero with blond hair, holding a blue lightsaber in a two-handed pose. Build as a sturdy, mostly rectangular “bigfig/minifig statue” with simple shaping and color blocking (white body, tan face/hands, blond hair, gray saber hilt, trans-light-blue blade).

subassemblies.name: Base/Feet Platform
subassemblies.description: Two blocky feet with a small shared base to keep the stance stable. Use mostly white bricks/plates; optional light bluish gray underlayer for strength.
subassemblies.image_location: Bottom of the model (under both feet).

subassemblies.name: Left Leg (front-left from viewer)
subassemblies.description: White rectangular leg with a slightly stepped knee/boot suggestion using plates/tiles. Add a tan/light-tan accent stripe motif if desired (to echo the printed leg pattern) using tan plates/tiles.

subassemblies.name: Right Leg (front-right from viewer)
subassemblies.description: Mirror of the left leg. Keep both legs solid (stacked bricks) to support the torso and arms.

subassemblies.name: Hip/Pelvis Belt Block
subassemblies.description: A 1-brick-tall “belt” band tying legs to torso: reddish brown/dark red stripe with a small centered buckle/pouch suggestion (red/dark red). This also acts as a structural bridge between the legs.
subassemblies.image_location: Across the waist, just above the legs.

subassemblies.name: Torso Core (White Robe)
subassemblies.description: Main chest/robe block in white. Suggest the V-neck wrap by using a few angled/stepped plates/tiles in white with small dark accents (black/dark bluish gray) for the robe opening lines, kept simple and symmetric.
subassemblies.image_location: Center mass of the figure, above the belt.

subassemblies.name: Back Support/Spine Stack
subassemblies.description: A hidden internal column (light bluish gray/dark bluish gray) running from hips into the torso to lock the model and provide an anchor for arms.
subassemblies.image_location: Inside the torso (not visible), aligned center-back.

subassemblies.name: Left Arm (upper + forearm)
subassemblies.description: Blocky white sleeve with a tan hand section at the end. Pose forward so both hands meet at the saber hilt; use simple hinge/offset via plates to angle the forearm inward.
subassemblies.image_location: Left side of torso, angled toward the center holding the hilt.

subassemblies.name: Right Arm (upper + forearm)
subassemblies.description: Matching white sleeve and tan hand, posed to cross slightly in front of the torso for the two-handed grip.
subassemblies.image_location: Right side of torso, angled toward the center holding the hilt.

subassemblies.name: Hands/Grip Connector
subassemblies.description: A small central grip block where both arms meet. Build a compact clamp-like assembly (using small plates/tiles) that securely attaches the lightsaber hilt and keeps the arms aligned.
subassemblies.image_location: Center-front of torso, just below chest level (where the hands meet).

subassemblies.name: Lightsaber Hilt
subassemblies.description: Cylindrical-looking gray/metallic hilt approximated with stacked round/curved elements if available, otherwise a short square-section handle in light/dark bluish gray with a small black accent band.
subassemblies.image_location: Held between both hands at center-front.

notes: Use mostly white (robes) and tan (face/hands) from the inventory; gray tones for internal structure and saber hilt; trans-clear pieces can be stacked/offset to suggest a glowing blade if trans-light-blue isn’t available—otherwise use trans-clear with a blue core strip.
Keep everything buildable with basic stacking: legs and torso as solid bricks; arms as simple rectangular beams attached to the torso sides; avoid fragile micro-connections.
For the blade, make a straight vertical stack rising up and to the upper-right; reinforce at the base by embedding 2–3 layers of plates around the hilt connection.
Hair can be a simple stepped “helmet” shape in tan/dark tan/yellow tones to evoke the blond look; keep it as one removable top module.
If you want a simpler build, omit robe line details and focus on silhouette: white body + tan head + yellow/tan hair + gray hilt + blue/trans blade.
